items: rc1c2c2 'Contact Us Book a Meeting Need...'

proposed_rules.trigger: A '2x1' zone with 'The best no-code platform for...' CTA text plus a '| |' separator at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as the site-wide footer fragment, excluded from per-page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical across every captured page = global chrome, analogous to knack-announcement-bar.

notes: Very small contact page: single CTA section ('Contact Us / Book a Meeting') plus nav, footer, cookie chrome. No unusual patterns.
